items.q: What is The One-Number Baby Budget?
items.a: A first-year household money system that replaces cart panic and silent shortfalls with one trusted budget number, a Buy/Wait/Never list, and a 30-day use audit. A written first-year budget both partners follow — so every baby purchase has a place, and nothing essential is missed for lack of a number.
Expecting and first-year parents in a household with irregular income in the first 12 months, facing new baby costs while pay is paused or shrunk

You get 6 components: The One-Number Budget Chart; The Real Baby Budget Quiz; Corner-Shop Cost-Swap Card; Buy / Wait / Never List; 30-Day Use Audit Log + Resell; Cart-Delete Loop Rescue. Together they let you the household can state one trusted budget number and keep a baby fund.
